description.text: A small independent shop interior in late afternoon, with a worn wooden counter, shelves of neatly stacked goods, and warm sunlight raking across the countertop from the front windows.

stands alone behind the counter, a middle-aged shopkeeper in a simple dark apron over a pale shirt, his sleeves rolled back. He finishes wiping the counter with a soft cloth, sets the cloth down, and lifts his head toward the front of the shop as the light shifts across his face. He speaks a short line evenly and without emphasis, hands resting on the counter. The camera holds a static shot, keeping the counter, the man, and the depth of the shop visible; the room is quiet, with a low refrigerator hum off-screen and the small handling sounds of the cloth and counter.
Late afternoon sunlight lies across the wooden counter and the shelves; the shop is still and quiet.
A low refrigerator hum runs continuously from off-screen.
